thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-84321 SERVICE=model-catalog-config severity=page -> Active catalog entry mismatch for rwd-model-7b; inference gateway error spike. Link: https://pd.redwood/pd/alerts/PD-84321

pagerduty: Alert PD-84321 (High) triggered and routed to eng-oncall escalation policy.

maya: acked. I'm on it, paging @ajay (model owner) and @jamie (sre). Any immediate customer impact? :eyes:

ajay: looking now. seeing a flood of decode errors and 502s from inference-gateway for rwd-model-7b. quick log snippet: 
```
2026-03-14T02:03:12Z inference-gateway rwd-model-7b rev=rev-2024-09-01 ERROR TokenizerMismatch: expected 'bpe-v2' got 'bpe-v1' input_id=aa3b...
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "serve.py", line 321, in handle_request
    tokens = tokenizer.decode(payload.tokens)
TokenizerMismatch: mismatched vocabulary version
```

jamie: confirmed. The model image running on nodes expects tokenizer bpe-v2 but catalog entry points at older revision. Running catalog query now.

ajay: output from catalog service: 
```
$ rwdctl catalog get rwd-model-7b --env prod
{
  "model": "rwd-model-7b",
  "catalog_revision": "rev-2023-11-02",
  "active_image": "sha256:1111deadbeef",
  "expected_tokenizer": "bpe-v2"
}
```

maya: so catalog thinks the active_image expects bpe-v2 but the catalog_revision listed is older? (confusing)

ajay: digging. It looks like CI pushed a new image (rev-2024-09-01) to the cluster but the catalog promotion job didn't update the catalog record; some nodes are serving new image while catalog metadata still references old revision; result: mismatch between route config and artifact metadata.

ops-lead: customer-impact check? @amy-cs please confirm affected customers and severity for comms.

amy-cs: telemetry shows ~12% 5xxs on the rwd-model-7b route in the last 10m. Top impacted orgs: acme-inc (key=k-ACME-01) and beta-startup (k-BETA-33). No PII leaked. CS will notify Acme ops and ask them to retry after 15m. Draft message prepared.

maya: mitigation plan: 1) pin the serving route to the catalog revision compatible with current image (or rollback image), 2) reconcile catalog->deploy pipeline, 3) monitor. I'm assigning step 1 to @ajay, step 2 to @jamie.

ajay: executing quick pin to stop error spike. commands: 
```
# option 1: temporarily override route to catalog revision known compatible
rwdctl serve override --route rwd-model-7b --revision rev-2023-11-02 --until 2026-03-14T04:00Z
# option 2: promote the catalog to match the deployed image (if safe)
rwdctl catalog promote --model rwd-model-7b --revision rev-2024-09-01 --force --reason "align tokenizer versions after emergency deploy"
```

ajay: choosing option 1 for lowest blast radius (pin back to older revision). Running now.

ajay: curl -> {"status":"ok","action":"override-applied"} ; verifying a sample call succeeds:
```
$ curl -H "Authorization: Bearer k-ACME-01" https://api.redwood.infer/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-model-7b","input":"hello"}'
{"status":"200","response":"..."}
```

incident-bot: PD-84321 acknowledged by maya at 2026-03-14T02:10:34Z.

amy-cs: CS notified Acme and Beta. Acme ops acknowledged and will retry; they reported 10 failed requests but say they can tolerate a short window.

jamie: watching logs and rolling metrics. Error rate dropping to baseline after override. I'll run reconciliation job to find how promotion job failed. Suspect race between deploy pipeline and promo worker.

ops-lead: quick customer impact summary for post-incident notes: 
- duration: ~15 minutes of elevated 5xxs for rwd-model-7b (02:00-02:15 UTC)
- affected: acme-inc (major), beta-startup (minor), ~8 smaller orgs
- mitigation: route pinned to rev-2023-11-02 at 02:08 UTC by ajay
- current status: stable, monitoring

maya: handoff to night SRE: @jamie will own monitoring and follow-up (reconcile catalog, add pipeline guard). Handoff notes: mitigation implemented, customers notified, CS will follow up with ACME.

jamie: taking over at 03:15 UTC. Immediate next actions: 1) run catalog-reconcile job manually and collect mismatches, 2) add alert for catalog vs deployed-image tokenizer mismatch, 3) schedule postmortem with ML/infra + CI owners.

ops-lead: postmortem owners: ajay (model owner), jamie (sre), maya (oncall lead), cs-amy (customer comms). ETA for initial report: 48h.

maya: thanks everyone. Closing on-call paging now; leave thread for handoff notes. :thumbsup:

jamie: will update thread with reconciliation output and next steps.

(End of thread)
